variants.headline: Home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.body: A ship from the home world has arrived in the colony. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: An arrival on the colonial route
variants.body: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: The distant connection comes into port
variants.body: A vessel from the home world has reached {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
